name: eu-ai-act-scanner
description: EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) and Digital Omnibus (Regulation 2026/1744) compliance harness for Claude Code and Codex. 22 code scanners, interactive visual context graph browser (/ai-act-graph), cryptographic compliance release dossier (/ai-act-dossier), cross-framework projection (/ai-act-cross-framework) mapping to NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OWASP LLM 2025, OWASP Agentic Top 10, and GDPR, plus autonomous remediation pipeline (/ai-act-scan-fix) with regression guard. Deep semantic audit mode leverages your active Claude Code or Codex subscription without additional API token costs.
author: Andrei Bacu (@Peaky8linders)
